title: Equipment
description: Represents a piece of equipment used for cleaning services with inventory tracking.

name.description: The name of the equipment (e.g., 'مكنسة كهربائية', 'Vacuum Cleaner').

condition.description: The current condition of the equipment.

quantity.description: The quantity of this equipment available.

supervisor.description: The supervisor responsible for this equipment.

lastMaintenanceDate.description: The date of the last maintenance (ISO 8601 date string).

nextMaintenanceDate.description: The scheduled date for the next maintenance (ISO 8601 date string).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the equipment was created (Firestore Timestamp).

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the equipment was last updated (Firestore Timestamp).
